== entry from text
"true" -> k flag yes
"false" -> k flag no

"-7" -> k integer -7
"3.5" -> k number 3.5
"-0.5" -> k number -0.5
"1e3" -> k number 1000
"0x10" -> k text "0x10"
"inf" -> k text "inf"
"nan" -> k text "nan"
"" -> k text ""
"hello" -> k text "hello"
"1.2.3" -> k text "1.2.3"
"9223372036854775807" -> k integer 9223372036854775807
